panels.description: Call outcomes per minute at the feature-server. Split by final status. The cluster-level answer to 'are calls succeeding?' — see RFC §4.1. Note: vg_feature_server_calls_total does not carry account_name today, so the $account_name filter is not applied; per-account drill-down is a follow-up (tracked in the RFC labeling gap).
panels.title: Call Outcomes (per min)

panels.description: Call termination reasons per minute. Rising 'bot' or 'caller' is normal traffic; rising 'media_server_failure' is OPERATIONAL.
panels.title: Call Termination Reasons

panels.description: 5-minute rolling call success rate. Matches RFC alert VGHighCallFailureRate (§6.2) when it drops below 85%.
panels.title: Call Success Rate (5m)

panels.description: User input (gather) timeout classification per minute, per account where available. Distinguishes 'timeout' (no-input) from 'speech_timeout' (started speaking but never completed).
panels.title: User Input Timeouts

panels.description: Gather with barge-in resolution outcomes: bargein_triggered (interrupted TTS), held_released (buffered), answered_after_tts (silent caller), no_speech (timeout), dtmf, stt_error. Use to answer 'is our gather+TTS working for this account?'
panels.title: Barge-in Outcomes

panels.description: SIP 4xx/5xx responses sent BY the feature server, per minute. Useful to correlate customer reports of call failures with specific SIP codes.
panels.title: SIP Error Responses (per min)

panels.description: Mid-call SIP re-INVITE outcomes (modify, hold, unhold, siprec, rejected, failed). Failures here break recording, transfer, or hold during an active call.
panels.title: SIP Re-INVITE Outcomes

panels.description: Forked-audio (Listen / external STT streaming) connection lifecycle events. 'failed'/'error' indicates customer WS sink unreachable.
panels.title: Forked Audio Connections (Listen)

panels.title: gRPC TTS Requests by Vendor

panels.description: gRPC streaming TTS errors per minute, by vendor and error_type.
panels.title: gRPC TTS Errors

panels.title: gRPC TTS Duration (p50 / p95)

panels.description: TTS vendor round-trip time, as reported by speech-utils (excludes cache lookup). Use alongside the TTS synthesis duration panel to separate vendor latency from VG-local overhead.

panels.description: gRPC streaming TTS 'stop' events that did not arrive within the expected timeout — indicates vendor or transport stall.
panels.title: gRPC TTS Timeouts (per min)

panels.description: Active FreeSWITCH channels, reported directly by mod_prometheus on each freeswitch pod. Preferred over the feature-server-polled `vg_feature_server_freeswitch_media_channels_*` gauges, which trail real state and can be imprecise.
panels.title: FreeSWITCH Active Channels (Native)

panels.description: FreeSWITCH media calls-per-second and CPU idle percentage. Idle falling below 20% signals saturation.
panels.title: FreeSWITCH Media CPS & CPU Idle

panels.description: FeatureServer-initiated hangups because no next AI command arrived in time. Grouped by tenant + the verb that completed last so support can see which tenants and which verbs (e.g. dial, gather) are most affected. See RFC §4.1 — this is the closest current signal to AI starvation per turn.
panels.title: Next-Command Timeouts (per min) — by Account / App / Verb

panels.description: Per-account rate of user-input timeouts during gather operations against the rate at which timers were reset by received input. A growing ratio of timeouts:resets implies callers aren't being heard (STT issues) or aren't speaking (UX issue).
panels.title: User Input Timeouts vs Resets (per min)

panels.description: Distribution of how long the feature server waited inside _awaitCommandsOrHangup before the next AI command, session end, or timeout. Excludes `last_completed_verb=dial` (call-bridge sessions sit in this wait for the entire bridged-call duration and would dominate the color scale). The closest proxy for AI response time per turn until `ai_response_duration_milliseconds` ships (RFC §4.1 gap).
panels.title: Next-Command Wait Distribution (excl. dial)

panels.description: Same metric scoped to the `dial` verb. Sessions that just completed a dial-and-bridge sit in _awaitCommandsOrHangup for the rest of the bridged call by design — so this heatmap's long tail reflects call duration rather than AI latency. Use it to confirm bridged calls are actually progressing; a 0-bucket spike here means dial sessions are not pausing and may be hanging up immediately post-bridge.
panels.title: Next-Command Wait Distribution (last_completed_verb=dial)

panels.description: Total Silero VAD audio forks started over the selected range, filtered by account.
panels.title: VAD Forks Started

panels.description: Total Silero VAD audio fork failures over the selected range. Red if >0 — fork failures break VAD-based barge-in for that call.
panels.title: VAD Fork Failures

panels.description: Total barge-ins triggered by Silero VAD over the selected range. Cross-check against `vg_feature_server_gather_bargein_outcome_total{outcome="bargein_triggered"}` for correctness — sustained divergence suggests the gather classifier is drifting from VAD.
panels.title: VAD Barge-ins Triggered

panels.description: Total Silero VAD fork starts that were skipped because the Cognigy session config did not opt in. High counts here are expected during rollout — confirms the opt-in gate is being hit.
panels.title: VAD Forks Skipped

panels.description: Started / failed / skipped Silero VAD fork rate per account. A failure spike for a single account usually points to a transcription-config issue; cluster-wide failures imply a feature-server or media-fork transport problem.
panels.title: VAD Fork Lifecycle (per min) — by Account

panels.description: Speech-started events from Silero VAD against the subset that escalated to a barge-in. The ratio is a sanity check that VAD is actually contributing to barge-in resolution rather than firing without effect.
panels.title: VAD Speech vs Barge-in (per min)

panels.description: Distribution of Silero VAD fork lifetimes. Closely tracks call length when VAD is active throughout the call. p95 plateauing far below call duration suggests forks are tearing down early (potential leak or premature close).
panels.title: VAD Fork Duration p50 / p95 (seconds)
